topic: React Components, Props, State, and Event Handling
learningObjectives: Differentiate props and state in React components.
Pass data between components using props.
Manage interactive UI behavior using state and events.

activities.title: Props vs State
activities.instruction: Match each data type to its correct React role.

content.concept: Props provide data to components, while state stores data that can change during component interaction.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Data Flow Explorer
activities.instruction: Trace how props move through components.

content.concept: React commonly follows a one-way data flow from parent components to child components.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: State Update Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust state values and observe the interface change.

content.concept: Updating component state causes React to render the affected interface with the new state value.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Interactive Component Builder
activities.instruction: Compose a component using props, state, and events.

content.concept: Interactive React components combine incoming props, local state, and event handlers.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
